SQL analysis using the public Google Analytics sample dataset.

E-commerce questions answered in SQL

A collection of BigQuery queries covering traffic, transactions, revenue and shopping behavior.

SQL · Google BigQuery · Google Analytics

The question

Web analytics data needs clear business questions and consistent aggregation.

The work

  • Aggregate visits, page views, transactions and revenue by month.
  • Compare bounce rates and revenue by traffic source.
  • Work with nested hit/product data to inspect purchasing behavior.

What the repository demonstrates

  • A public SQL analysis file contains the query collection against the Google Analytics sample dataset.

What I learned

  • Work with nested data, date-sharded tables and business metric definitions.

Project context

  • No saved result image was present. The source queries were inspected, not rerun.
  • Revenue unit conversions differ in parts of the historical query file; avoid publishing derived revenue claims without review.
Source references

This is a curated local case study based on the public project repository, not a rerun of the original analysis.
